name: Text shaping and rendering library in JavaScript and no_std Rust

mentions.name: Text shaping and rendering library in JavaScript and no_std Rust
mentions.description: A complex text shaping and rendering library implemented in both JavaScript and no_std Rust, supporting ligatures, bidirectional text, Arabic, Indic, CJK, Khmer, and other scripts. It is designed to be super small and memory efficient: the JS version is under 25 KB gzipped and the Rust version targets roughly 130 KB compiled. A demo running on an ESP32 is planned.
mentions.source_excerpt: A complex text shaping and rendering library in Javascript and no_std Rust that supports Ligatures, Bidi, Arabic, indic, CJK, Khmer, etc and is super small and memory efficient. JS version is <25 KB gripped, Rust version is aimed at approx. 130 KB compiled size. My plan is to show a demo of it running on an esp32 soon.
